quotes.text: I had a great time as the keynote speaker at the Joy Club luncheon hosted by First Methodist Church Waco! I shared my insights on the future of AI and its potential in healthcare, education, navigation, and security. Embracing new technologies is essential, but we must ensure AI is implemented with care and proper oversight for safety and accountability. Together, we can harness these innovations for a brighter future.

Artificial intelligence is reshaping how we prevent fraud and modernize government operations. Today, I spoke during a @GOPoversight hearing about the critical role AI can play in improving efficiency, safeguarding taxpayer dollars, and strengthening trust in government. The future of good governance and zero fraud depends on innovation.

I enjoyed speaking this morning at @politico's AI & Tech Summit. It was great to share my perspective and to hear from administration leaders and industry experts on the transformative potential of AI, particularly in data organization and government technology. The federal government has an important role in the development of how AI technology is used and regulated. I look forward to the opportunities ahead as we continue exploring how AI can drive innovation and improve government services.

I’m proud to Co-lead the REAL Act, which brings greater transparency and accountability to the federal government’s use of artificial intelligence. Our bill requires federal agencies and officials to clearly disclose when text, images, audio, or video shared with the public in their official capacity has been generated or manipulated using AI. This legislation protects agencies’ ability to use AI internally while ensuring that anything released publicly is clearly and consistently labeled. It is a commonsense step to maintain trust and strengthen transparency in government communications.

I introduced the bipartisan REAL Act with @RepBillFoster to bring transparency and accountability to how artificial intelligence is used by the federal government. 

Transparency builds trust, and this legislation is about making sure new technology is used responsibly and honestly.
